findings.citation_text: However, the widespread adoption of low-cost RFID tags and the richness of their sensing capabilities, particularly their through-wall sensing ability, render non-negligible privacy concerns [13–15]. Numerous studies have shown successful attempts in through-wall human motion [3–5] and speech eavesdropping [15–18] via RFID tags for adversarial uses.
